page_title: SOU 1-5 CHE | Southampton v Chelsea 04/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+4' The game is interrupted as Malo Gusto (Chelsea) is flagged offside.
90+3' Chelsea seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
90+2' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Joao Felix (Chelsea).
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
87' 1 - 5 Jadon Sancho (Chelsea) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and curls the ball inside the right post in trademark fashion.
85' Chelsea quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
83' Joao Felix (Chelsea) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
79' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall (Chelsea) comes onto the pitch so that Cole Palmer can be given a rest.
79' Substitution. Renato Veiga (Chelsea) on for Marc Cucurella.
79' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Charlie Taylor (Southampton) will replace Mateus Fernandes.
78' Russell Martin has decided to substitute James Bree and he is replaced by Ronnie Edwards (Southampton).
77' Christopher Nkunku (Chelsea) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
76' 1 - 4 Goal 1:4! Cole Palmer (Chelsea) taps home from close range after the rebound fell kindly into his path.
72' Enzo Maresca has decided to make a change. Jadon Sancho (Chelsea) replaces Noni Madueke.
72' Noni Madueke (Chelsea) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls it and sends it straight at Joe Lumley, who makes a comfortable save.
72' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Cameron Archer as he is replaced by Yukinari Sugawara (Southampton).
68' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
66' A cross into the box from Kyle Walker-Peters (Southampton) is cleared.
66' Southampton work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
65' Noni Madueke (Chelsea) attempts a lovely volley but it's saved by the keeper.
63' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
62' Substitution. Adam Armstrong is replaced by Ben Brereton Diaz (Southampton).
62' Russell Martin decides to make a substitution. Ryan Fraser will be replaced by Kamaldeen Sulemana (Southampton).
59' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball is out of play and Chelsea manage to earn a corner.
57' An amazing save by the keeper! Cole Palmer (Chelsea) unleashes a great shot, but the goalkeeper shows good anticipation and keeps the ball out.
55' Chelsea have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
53' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) unleashes a shot, but it's well wide of the right-hand post.
53' The resulting corner falls to Tosin Adarabioyo (Chelsea), who smashes the ball against the right post.
52' Chelsea force a corner. They send men into the box.
50' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Southampton.
47' Tony Harrington shows a yellow card to Adam Armstrong (Southampton), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
46' Cole Palmer crosses and Joao Felix (Chelsea) misses a great opportunity with his head from close in, sending the ball just wide of the right post.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+6' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+5' The resulting set piece from Chelsea is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
45+5' A long ball forward to Joao Felix (Chelsea) is intercepted.
45+3' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) has an effort from distance but it's blocked.
45+2' Kyle Walker-Peters (Southampton) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Filip Jorgensen, who smothers the ball.
45+2' Southampton take a short corner kick.
45+1' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Ryan Manning (Southampton), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. The linesman makes the right call and Southampton will have a corner.
45' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
45' Christopher Nkunku (Chelsea) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
41' The corner from James Bree (Southampton) is intercepted by the defence.
39' Red card! Jack Stephens (Southampton) is given a red card for his behaviour.
38' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he’s going to review that incident from earlier. It could result in a red card, but for who as a number of players were involved?
34' 1 - 3 Noni Madueke (Chelsea) collects a sweet pass and fires a low shot into the bottom left corner. What a goal!
31' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) shoots from the free kick towards the goal, but mishits the shot as it goes high over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty!
26' Post! Tosin Adarabioyo (Chelsea) outjumps the defence to connect with the resulting corner and attempts to head home, but his effort only rattles the right post.
25' The ball is out of play. Chelsea will have a chance to score from a corner.
24' James Bree (Southampton) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.

23' Noni Madueke (Chelsea) bursts into the box after a fine solo run. He looks up and tries to rifle a shot into the middle of the goal, but Joe Lumley makes a great save to deny him his moment of glory.
21' Ryan Manning (Southampton) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
20' Ryan Manning (Southampton) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
19' Southampton take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
19' Kyle Walker-Peters (Southampton) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Southampton force their opponents to concede a corner.
17' 1 - 2 Goal! Christopher Nkunku (Chelsea) seizes on the loose ball after a huge error from Joe Lumley and finds the back of the net from inside the box. 1:2.
15' Adam Armstrong (Southampton) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
14' Neat passing move from Southampton in order to create new attacking opportunities.
11' 1 - 1 Joe Aribo (Southampton) collects a sweet pass and fires a low shot into the bottom right corner, leaving the keeper helpless.
7' 0 - 1 Axel Disasi (Chelsea) latches on to a precise corner kick and beats the keeper with a fine header!
6' The ball goes out of play. Chelsea are awarded a corner kick.
3' A toe poke from Joe Aribo (Southampton) heads right for the middle of the goal, but Filip Jorgensen is well placed and makes a good save.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Chelsea will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Tony Harrington.
